structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a grand event venue building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant striped marquee tent and bunting on its roof.
character: young events intern (a Middle Eastern man in his early 20s, short dark curly hair, black polo shirt, headset round his neck)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and reviews a schedule on a clipboard beside a laptop timeline of coloured abstract bars.
he talks on the phone beside boxes of decorations and a venue floor plan made of simple shapes.
he lays out name badges and welcome bags on a long registration table.
he arranges rows of chairs and checks a stage microphone with a sound technician.
he welcomes smiling guests at the entrance with a tablet as fairy lights glow; dusk through the window.
props: a giant balloon, confetti, blank ticket stubs, a spotlight, a microphone, a calendar, party streamers
